characterDescription: A minimal, structurally bare navigation with no decorative chrome — no background treatment, no shadow, no border — relying entirely on spatial rhythm and typography to establish hierarchy. The added letter-spacing (0.08em) on nav links amplifies the geometric typeface's formal uppercase register, lending each item a considered, editorial weight. The static positioning and zero padding suggest an inline or embedded nav context.
_twist: Twist D: Letter spacing on nav links at intensity 3 — 0.08em letter-spacing added. Source: phamilypharma.
